title: Compose Task and Approval reads in the PWA

gates.name: task_follow_up_browser
gates.command: cd frontend && npm run test:e2e -- tests/e2e/task-follow-up.spec.ts

verify: Independent browser verification covers only exact Task and Approval read projections, filters, role/archive behavior, canonical request paths, and absence of write/arbitrary-Task capability.
evidence_required: FT-016-AC-025 RED: no browser Task/Approval read consumer exists; GREEN: authorized lists render exact filtered projections while denied/archive/canonical-path failures stay safe and no write or arbitrary-Task request is emitted; decisive comparison: protected responses versus DOM plus request allowlist; artifact: Task/Approval read evidence under .tasks/TASK-088-T3-FT-016-W3/.
purpose: Expose the exact Task and Approval projections without transferring action clearance, mutation, or Task authority to the PWA.
success_outcome: Authorized users can read exact filtered Task and Approval lists with truthful denial/archive behavior while the PWA emits no lifecycle mutation or arbitrary Task request.
anti_goals: Do not add Safety approval, Task completion, Outcome recording, arbitrary Task creation, schedulers/reminders, or device commands.
Do not treat UI state or governance approval as Safety approval.

forbidden_scope: backend Safety, Approval, Task, Outcome, and Dataset authority
arbitrary Task/action creation or device execution
stop_conditions: A required user action is outside Task And Approval HTTP.
The PWA would need to infer Safety clearance, evidence freshness, permission, or lifecycle state.

constraints: Primary owner is Operator PWA; Task & Follow-Up owns all lifecycle and mutation authority.
Use exact read filters and backend-derived permission/status results; emit no command body.
invariants: Read presentation grants no Safety clearance, completion, Outcome, or device authority.
Archived or denied records remain retained and non-operative without a write request.
verification_targets: FT-016-AC-025: exact Task and Approval read fields/filters, role/archive handling, canonical paths, and zero mutation request.
T3 harm proof uses isolated records and verifies denied/malformed reads leave no transition or device effect.
